sentences.text: The petitioner prays for the issuance of a writ in the nature of certiorari to quash the order passed on 01.08.2012, whereby, he has been restrained from continuing in service.

In substance, it is the case of the respondent-State that the petitioner was appointed on the basis of a fake appointment letter manipulated by the petitioner in connivance with his father Sh. Mohinder Singh, Senior Assistant, who was dealing assistant in the Ministerial Establishment.
It has come on record that a vigilance case was registered vide FIR No.1 dated 24.01.2013 against the petitioner as well as his father.
The Special Court has held both the accused guilty of charge framed against them.

Mohinder Singh has been convicted under Section 120-B, 409, 420, 468, 471 of IPC and Section 13(2) read with Section 13(1)
(d) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, whereas, the petitioner was convicted under Section 120-B, 420, 468, 471 IPC.
2.
The appeal against the judgment of conviction of sentence is stated to be pending.

sentences.text: 3. This Bench has heard the learned counsel representing the parties at length and with their able assistance perused the paperbook.

4. On the one hand, the learned Senior counsel representing the petitioner contends that a large scale bungling has taken place in the appointment of Senior Laboratory Attendants and the petitioner is sought to be victimized.
He submits that the registration number allotted to the petitioner is 50041015, which is tallying with the appointment letter.

5. On the other hand, the learned counsel representing the State of Punjab submits that the petitioner managed to get a fake appointment letter issued because of his father, hence, he does not deserve any relief.
6. It is evident that the highly disputed questions of fact are required to be adjudicated.
The respondents while filing the written statement has claimed that the appointment letter is fake.

Moreover, additional affidavit of Assistant Registrar in the Office of Director Public Instructions (Secondary Education) has also been filed reiterating the aforesaid facts.
7.

entities.text: Office of Director Public Instructions (Secondary Education)
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Keeping in view the aforesaid discussion, the petitioner is relegated to the alternative remedy.
8. Disposed of accordingly.
9. All the pending miscellaneous applications, if any, are also disposed of.
